Today Apple launched its latest flagship phones, the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max. Although the two Pro models are largely the same, each has one exclusive advantage.

#1: iPhone 18 Pro uses C2 modem, while iPhone 18 Pro Max sticks with Qualcomm

Apple began transitioning its products to in-house cellular modems starting with the iPhone 16e in early 2025, first releasing the C1 modem, then following up with the C1X successor on the iPhone Air last autumn.

Now Apple has unveiled the next-generation C2 modem and applied it to the iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro, but the iPhone 18 Pro Max has not adopted it, which is puzzling.

According to Apple's tech specs page, the C2 and the Qualcomm modem in the iPhone 18 Pro Max have similar specifications, and both support mmWave in the US.

However, Apple's own-designed modem does offer some exclusive advantages that Pro Max users will miss out on.

#2: iPhone 18 Pro Max battery life boost far exceeds iPhone 18 Pro

Both the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max see battery improvements this year, but as earlier rumours suggested, Apple reserved the more significant upgrade for the Pro Max model.

Below is the official battery life comparison between this year's new models and last year's:

Battery Life (video playback) iPhone 18 Pro up to 36 hours iPhone 18 Pro Max up to 45 hours iPhone 17 Pro up to 33 hours iPhone 17 Pro Max up to 39 hours

From this, the iPhone 18 Pro Max gains six additional hours of video playback, while the iPhone 18 Pro only gains three.

The Pro Max has long been Apple's battery life champion, and the iPhone 18 Pro Max extends that lead further than ever.
